description.value: The Okanagan Science Centre is a hands-on science museum located in Polson Park, Vernon, featuring two floors of interactive exhibits covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, and environmental science. It operates a planetarium and offers more than 30 curriculum-aligned education programs for students from Pre-K to Grade 7+. As a registered charity, it also hosts birthday parties, sleepovers, and summer science camps, making it a family-oriented stop on a Vernon cycling tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Okanagan Science Centre is a legitimate science museum at 2704 Hwy 6 (Polson Park) in Vernon, which matches the OSM address (Vernon-Slocan Highway = Hwy 6). Critically, the website prominently reports a May 15, 2026 structural fire that has closed the facility, with a phased reopening targeted for June 2; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched pages. Because none of the required or optional amenities are referenced in the website content and there are no relevant OSM amenity tags, all amenity values default to null.
